children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Dabur

At Dabur’s analyst meet, newly appointed CEO Mr. Herjit S. Bhalla outlined “IGNITE” as the roadmap for the second half of Vision VII (FY25 28). The emphasis was on sharper execution of existing initiatives rather than new announcements, and a refreshed strategy is expected in six months. Dabur has 27 brands with turnover above INR1b, seven category leading brands contributing ~50% of revenue, reach across ~8.5mn outlets and penetration in eight out of 10 Indian households.

The sustainability of demand momentum and commodity inflation remain key monitorables in FY27.The strategy refresh in six months should provide better visibility on the next leg of growth. We reiterate our Neutral rating on the stock with a TP of INR425 (30x Sep’28E EPS).
